leads.title: Nom Them All
leads.author: starringmoon
leads.description: Defeat weaker enemies to steal their stats until you are strong enough to eat them all
leads.pitch_sfx: His punchy sound design would deliver satisfying audio feedback for enemy consumption and stat stealing, making each action feel impactful.
leads.pitch_music: The heavy, doom-laden music style could create a suitably oppressive and intense atmosphere for a horror game focused on brutal progression.
leads.reason: The game's core mechanics of consuming and growing stronger, combined with its horror tag, present a strong opportunity for the sound designer's atmospheric and punchy SFX as well as their heavy music.

leads.title: Ghools & Gunkheads
leads.author: WasWorld Industries
leads.description: Take on some cryptids having a house party as a swamp loving hillbilly
leads.pitch_sfx: His atmospheric and punchy sound design would excel at creating the brooding, immersive environments of a cryptid house party, while delivering satisfyingly impactful SFX for all the gunkhead antics.
leads.pitch_music: The developer's mention of horror and the general theme of the game strongly suggest a need for heavy, driving music that would perfectly align with his metalcore, doom, and argent metal expertise to amp up the chaotic fun.
leads.reason: The game's theme of cryptids and a hillbilly protagonist in a horror context is a perfect playground for his atmospheric and punchy sound design, as well as his heavy music skills.
